ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
title: Nominations invited for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar Awards 2026
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Women and Child Development

Nominations invited for Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar Awards 2026

Last date for submission of applications is 31st July

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
02 JUL 2026 1:10PM by PIB Delhi

The Ministry of Women and Child Development reiterates its call for nominations to the Pradhan Mantri Rashtriya Bal Puraskar Awards (PMRBP) 2026. The last date for submission of applications is 31
st
 July 2026. All nominations for the PMRBP award must be made through the online portal
https://awards.gov.in
.

This is a unique recognition to celebrate the extraordinary achievements of children aged 5 to 18 years who have demonstrated excellence in the fields of Sports, Social Service, Science and Technology, Environment, Art and Culture. The award is also presented to those who have exhibited an extreme degree of bravery in trying circumstances.

Any citizen, school, institution, or organisation can nominate candidates they deem deserving. Children may also apply through self-nomination.

Particulars of the Application process are as follows:

Deadline: 31
st
 July 2026

Mode: Online only

Portal:
https://awards.gov.in

Applicants will need to fill in basic personal details and category of award and then upload a recent photograph and supporting documents. They will also need to submit a write-up (up to 1000-words) about the achievement and its impact.

The Ministry encourages schools, youth groups, NGOs, panchayats, and individuals to use this final month to identify and support potential nominees. Let us together ensure that India’s youngest trailblazers are given the recognition they deserve.
